title: Profile switch with full settings.json replacement (F-004)
description: Implement two-phase profile switch: Phase 1 clears all feature entries from settings.json, Phase 2 writes new profile's non-default values. Core config (base.*, providers.*) always updates regardless of toggle. Feature config respects sync toggle state - clear always, write only if toggle ON. This prevents stale entries from previous profiles remaining in settings.json.

criteria: syncOnProfileSwitch() method updated with 2-phase clear-then-write logic
Phase 1: iterates all REVERSE_FEATURE_MAP entries and clears those with globalValue or workspaceValue defined
Phase 2: iterates again, writes non-default values respecting toggle state
Core config keys (isCoreConfigKey) always written regardless of toggle
Feature config keys written only if isSyncEnabled is true AND value !== default
convergence.definition_of_done: Profile switch performs full replacement of settings.json entries, respecting toggle and core config classification

files.change: Replace syncOnProfileSwitch implementation with two-phase clear-then-write logic using isCoreConfigKey classification and toggle check

implementation.title: Rewrite syncOnProfileSwitch with two-phase strategy
implementation.description: Replace the current simple syncOnProfileSwitch with a two-phase implementation: clear all feature entries, then write new profile values respecting core/feature classification and toggle state.
modification_points: Add Phase 1 loop: clear all REVERSE_FEATURE_MAP entries that have globalValue or workspaceValue
Add Phase 2 loop: write non-default values with isCoreConfigKey check and toggle check
logic_flow: Phase 1: For each REVERSE_FEATURE_MAP entry, inspect config, clear if has user-defined value
Phase 2: For each entry, get value from settings param, get default from DEFAULT_FEATURE_SETTINGS
If isCoreConfigKey(dotPath) and value !== default: write
If isFeatureConfigKey(dotPath) and isSyncEnabled and value !== default: write

pre_analysis.action: Review current syncOnProfileSwitch and profile manager call sites

artifacts.usage: Two-phase replacement strategy and toggle-aware profile switch

rationale.why: Prevent stale entries from previous profiles in settings.json
rationale.approach: Two-phase clear-then-write ensures clean state before applying new profile

risks.risk: Phase 1 completes but Phase 2 fails, leaving settings.json partially cleared
risks.mitigation: globalState always has correct profile data; next sync cycle will fix. Non-atomic but safe due to globalState fallback.
